stories.headline: US tightens Iran blockade to stop ship-to-ship transfers
body: CENTCOM warned ships taking Iranian cargo via ship-to-ship transfers could be stopped, boarded or seized.
It aims to close a loophole that let some Iranian fuel reach buyers.
Tension around Hormuz remains high.
stories.vc: Tighter blockades keep oil markets jumpy.

stories.headline: Israeli drone strikes kill seven in central Gaza
body: Israeli attacks killed at least seven Palestinians in central Gaza despite the ceasefire.
Four died when a drone hit Bureij refugee camp, medical sources said.
Residents describe fear as drones buzz overhead.

stories.headline: UK weighs a 'Breturn' to the EU after its Brussels summit
body: PM Andy Burnham is back from a UK-EU summit with a possible new deal.
A decade after the referendum, the UK shows signs of buyer's remorse.
The 'Breturn' debate is growing.
stories.joke: It's not you, EU, it's us. Can we talk?
stories.vc: Closer EU ties could help UK trade and the pound.

stories.headline: Flipkart's sale timing dents Walmart's international growth
body: Flipkart's Big Billion Days timing cut about 5 points from Walmart International's Q3 sales growth.
Walmart expects that to come back in Q4.
International net sales still rose 7% to $35.9 billion.
stories.joke: Big Billion Days, small billion quarter.
stories.vc: Flipkart's festive sales swing results for its US parent.

stories.headline: Amazon Prime India head Abhinav Agarwal quits
body: Abhinav Agarwal, who led Amazon Prime in India, has left after 16 years.
He ran product, marketing and engineering for Prime.
His next role will focus on commerce and logistics.
stories.vc: Senior exits come as Amazon fights Flipkart and quick commerce.

stories.headline: Spotify's Daniel Ek backs an AI researcher's fusion startup
body: Daniel Ek is backing Europa Fusion, a UK startup founded in February.
Founder Nantas Nardelli worked at Google DeepMind and was ML head at Pacific Fusion.
It's taking a different approach to fusion power.
stories.vc: Tech billionaires are betting on power for AI data centres.

stories.headline: GTA 6 adds a new mission: being a good partner
body: GTA 6 challenges the series' hypermasculine traditions on gender and relationships, The 19th says.
It's the first new instalment since 2013.
It made over $1 billion in pre-sales.
stories.vc: Wider appeal to women gamers grows the market.
